about_the_game:
⚔️ Vocabulary running low? Tired of boring word drills?

Time to summon your inner hero—because this English vocabulary RPG is here to save the day!

Fight monsters, level up, and expand your vocabulary effortlessly through thrilling adventures.
Who knew learning English could be this addictive?

🎮 Game Overview

Elegy of Fate: Lexical Heroes is a unique RPG designed to expand your English vocabulary through gameplay.
If you’ve ever felt lost about how to improve your word power—or simply bored by endless flashcards—this game offers a fresh, immersive solution.

When English learning transforms into a fantasy adventure, every word becomes the key to awakening powerful Spirits.
Elegy of Fate: Lexical Heroes breaks the boundary between education and entertainment, leading you on a journey where knowledge and courage coexist.

Here, memorizing words is no longer a burden—it’s the core power that drives your hero forward.
Master words, cast spells, and unlock a new level of language fluency while fully immersed in the magic of battle!

🌍 World Setting

The story continues within the world of Yusiaid, from the previous title Chaos Entropy (formerly Elegy of Fate: Light and Shadow).
You play as a novice entering Lunrant Magic Academy, the continent’s most prestigious school for mages.
New students must learn how to wield Spirit Cards to summon legendary heroes known as Spirits.
To control them in combat, you must accumulate magic incantations—English words—and become a true Spirit Summoner.

⚡ Core Gameplay

📖 Vocabulary Battle System

Battles are no longer just about numbers.
When facing monsters, words appear on the screen—you must quickly choose the correct meaning from several options.
Each correct answer restores your Spirit’s mana, enabling you to cast powerful spells.
Choose incorrectly, and your chanting time will decrease; once it reaches zero, the spell backfires and damages your Spirit.

For example, when fighting a Flame Demon, the word ignite appears.
If you correctly select “to set on fire,” your Spirit instantly regains mana and can unleash a devastating fire spell.
This tight fusion of language learning and combat keeps every battle exciting—turning vocabulary practice into a thrilling, skill-based challenge.

🧭 Spirit Collection & Growth

Through exploration across Yusiaid, you can encounter and summon over 50 unique Spirits, each with distinct personalities, abilities, and stories.
Use Spirit Summon Cards to recruit them, strengthen their skills, and create powerful team combinations.
Your mastery of vocabulary—combined with smart strategy—determines victory on the battlefield.

🏰 A Journey of Knowledge and Courage

Step into Elegy of Fate: Lexical Heroes, where every word carries power, and every battle sharpens your mind.
Learn, fight, and grow as you journey through this magical realm—
because in this world, words are the strongest spells of all.

So what are you waiting for?
Embark on your adventure today, and rewrite your destiny with knowledge!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 * 1800) or equivalent; AMD Phenom II X4 965 (4 * 3400) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce MX 150 ( 2048 MB); Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400) or equivalent; AMD FX-8350 (8 * 4700) or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 ( 2048 MB); Radeon RX 580 (8192 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 12 MB available space

short_description: You are a new student at Lunrant Magic Academy, the top magic school on the continent of Yusiaid. Here, you’ll learn to control Spirit Cards and summon mighty Spirits. By mastering magic spells (English words), you’ll guide your Spirits in battle and grow into a powerful Spirit Summoner.
